tr.td:
It is not allowed to issue an invoice to TÜV AUSTRIA without this written assignment.
The Audit Documentation has to be delivered to the Certification Body the latest two weeks after the Audit conduction.

All the members of the audit team have signed the declaration of independence/impartiality, in which they are committed that there is no professional relationship of any kind and have not provided any kind of advisory service or any kind of service (internal audits, design / development of management system) for the company being audited, or another company legally associated with this company, during the last two (2) years, at least. Also they are committed that they will not develop any kind of cooperation and / or advisory service, during the next two (2) years after the audit. Finally they are committed that there is no conflict of interest with the company being audited due to previous or current relationship. If any of the above is not fulfilled, the member of the audit team shall notify to TÜV AUSTRIA HELLAS in writing

td.p: TÜV AUSTRIA has decided, to not include personal information of identified natural persons of any kind (in short “personal data”) in the documentation files. Because of this decision, the auditors will conduct the audit as described by the relevant audit and certification documents of TÜV AUSTRIA, applicable for each specific service, and record the evidence of conformity, in the documentation, in such a way that no natural person can, directly or indirectly, be identified. (e.g. the auditor can choose to use initials or first names only when recording the data subjects name). This prohibition of recording personal data applies also to information in hard copies (paper) or in electronic formats (screenshots, electronic files etc). The auditor will check before accepting the above mentioned evidence that the natural person this evidence concerns can not be identified. If this is not the case, the auditor will not accept to receive the evidence until proper measures are taken.

If there is a need for processing information of natural persons in the documentation, the personal data protocol document will need to be filled in and signed by both parties. The auditor is obligated to inform the DPO of the applicable TÜV AUSTRIA Company immediately and no later than the end of the audit, regarding the exchange of personal data, and submit the document for safe keeping to the company. The auditor will not keep a copy of the relevant file.

All files and data regarding the audit has to be kept and transferred in a secure way. (e.g. encrypted e-mail attachments, encrypted disk folders etc). In case the auditor does not know how to enforce these measures, the auditor should communicate with the TÜV AUSTRIA Company IT personnel in order to receive guidance. Failure to comply with these rules, is eligible for disciplinary action.
In case of an incident (breach), contact immediately the DPO of the relevant TÜV AUSTRIA Company. (dpo-xx@tuv.at)
